# Import exclusions

Superseded archive/ and source_documents/gemini_ocr_archive/ are excluded entirely.
Rendered OCR pages, experimental roster outputs, processed TIFFs, and generated map tiles remain in the legacy workspace. Source maps and geographic inputs are copied instead.
No credentials, live database, dump, obsolete application, or external roster project was copied.
Current import does not infer that absent files are unavailable elsewhere.
